_comment: Water visual-overhaul pass (2026-09-03, see unreal/apply_water_material.py) - unlike content_src/textures/{ground,road,building}/ this is NOT a downloaded CC0 photo set. generate_water_normal.py procedurally SYNTHESIZES one tileable ripple normal map (integer-frequency sine-grating sum, wrapped central-difference gradient - see that script's own docstring for why this tiles with zero seam by construction). Deterministic (fixed RNG seed) - re-running the generator reproduces the exact same PNG bit-for-bit. Same tracked-script/untracked-binary convention as the other content_src/textures/ sets (see repo .gitignore) even though there's no download step here.

textures.license: Original work (procedurally generated by this repo's own script) - no third-party asset, no attribution required.
textures.format: PNG, tangent-space normal map (OpenGL/UE convention, 0.5,0.5,1.0 = flat)
textures.notes: Sampled TWICE by apply_water_material.py at different UV tiling + pan speed/direction (two-layer panning-normal look) - one bake, two material-time samples, rather than shipping two separate texture files.
